title: Customer Case Study & Testimonial Films
description: Authentic, interview-led customer stories and peer testimonials that build unshakeable commercial trust and accelerate enterprise sales cycles.
seoTitle: Client Case Study Video Production | Cambridge & London
seoDescription: B2B customer case study films and client testimonials filmed across Cambridge and London. Authentic peer-proof videos that shorten sales cycles and win trust.
heroHeading: Let your clients do the *talking for you.*
heroLead: Enterprise buyers rarely commit without hearing from peers who solved the same challenges. We film your clients in their workplace, capturing authentic voices, real-world deployments, and clear outcomes that give decision-makers commercial confidence.
breakdownBody: Some contributors shine in relaxed conversation, while others rely on an on-camera teleprompter to stay strictly on-message. We adapt our setup on-site, ensuring technical experts and executives speak comfortably, clearly, and without rehearsed stiffness.

deliverables.title: The Core Customer Film (2–3 Mins)
deliverables.description: A clear, documentary-style film tracing the deployment, technical challenge, and real-world results, combining focused interviews with cinematic B-roll of your product, team, and facility in daily operation.

deliverables.title: Topic-Specific Cutdowns & Social Clips
deliverables.description: Focused 30-to-60 second vertical and widescreen excerpts with styled subtitles. Each clip isolates a single challenge or outcome, ready for LinkedIn and direct email exchanges with prospective buyers.

deliverables.title: Production Stills & Verified Transcripts
deliverables.description: High-resolution on-location photography of your client in their workspace, delivered alongside timecoded interview transcripts and approved pull-quotes for your written case studies, proposals, and press releases.

ctaHeading: Have a client story ready to *document?*
ctaDescription: Tell us about your client, their location, and your preferred timeline. We can then provide a clear quote.
